text:
sana: quick proposal: add a "preflight runtime contract" into model onboarding. small, deterministic checks run inside the target runtime container to catch tokenization and kv-cache incompatibilities before we push to canary. aim for ~60s. thoughts?

vik: short answer: yes. long answer: need to be explicit about what we block on vs what we warn on. tokenization mismatch = hard block. perf regressions = soft.

omar: agree. also add a SHA for the tokenizer artifact and the runtime so we can tie failures to exact builds. otherwise debugging is painful.

jin: interface suggestion: shim as an adapter with three calls: tokenize_debug(input) -> (tokens, debug_hint), kv_smoke(seq_len) -> status, latencies, and runtime_metadata() -> {bin_hash, libs}. makes it easy to add new runtimes.

sana: nice. i want the shim to live in bench-runner as an optional step and be pluggable. default enabled for new model submissions; owners can opt-out but must accept advisory flag on onboarding.

vik: where should this run? options: (A) in bench CI (cheap, shared), (B) ephemeral runner that pulls the runtime image (most realistic), (C) hosted integration infra. i'd vote (B) with pull cache and retry.

omar: (B) also surfaces image-level link-time issues (missing symbols) which we want to catch. cost is image pulls and transient infra. we should rate-limit runs for large batch imports.

jin: a couple of engineering nitpicks: normalise strings (NFKC) before tokenization diffs, and compare token ids not surface strings to avoid minor unicode display differences. also include a truncated diff artifact (first 200 chars) in logs.

infra-bot: FYI: recent week had intermittent dockerHub rate limits in eu-central; recommend mirroring and exponential backoff.

sana: policy sketch:
- blocking failures: tokenizer id mismatch, runtime crash on kv probe, deterministic decoding divergence for golden set
- advisory failures: tps below threshold, occasional 95th percentile slow tail
- on blocking failure: mark onboarding failed and create a triage ticket with logs + binary hashes

vik: for golden set: require model owner to supply 3 golden prompts capturing edge behavior (multibyte, long prefix, subword boundaries). we provide a default 5-item set if owner doesn't supply.

omar: logging: produce a compact artifact with {tokenizer_sha, runtime_sha, tokenize_diff: <path to diff>, kv_trace: <path>, perf: {tps, p50,p95}}. store artifact in bench artifacts bucket and surface link in the onboarding UI.

jin: also add a short human-friendly summary line: e.g., "tokenizer: OK, kv-probe: crash, perf: advisory (4800 tps < 5k)" so reviewers can triage quickly.

sana: action items: (1) i'll prototype adapter spec + runner harness in bench-runner (2) jin will draft the adapter interface and example adapter for llm-runtime (3) omar will add tokenizer artifact pinning to model metadata + storage rules (4) vik will estimate infra cost and rate-limits for bulk imports. i'll open a PR for the spec.

vik: add finance tag to the PR so we can get a quick CI-cost ack.

infra-bot: noted. remember to include region-mirror config.

sana: one more: we should include a remediation path in the UI when a model fails the shim: offer options to (a) upload corrected tokenizer, (b) re-run with different image tag, or (c) contact infra for help. reduces back-and-forth.

omar: +1. good UX reduces velocity cost.

jin: cool — will start adapter stubs this week.

sana: thanks all. i'll post the PR link and a short demo recording when prototype is ready. :rocket:
